title: One Open Job per Loss and Separate Ledgers in Water Damage Mitigation
content:
This Water Damage Mitigation standard governs how a new dispatch relates to jobs already open for the same loss, and how money moves between jobs.

## The standard
No other water job of the same customer for the same loss address and the same loss date may be open when a new dispatch is booked. A repeat call about a loss that already has an open job is handled on that existing job as a return visit, and a job is open in every status except closed and cancelled. Jobs are never combined for billing: each payment, insurance posting, credit or refund names exactly one job and moves only that job's balance, and a credit balance on one job is refunded from that job rather than moved to another job of the same customer.

## Basis of the check
- The check rests on the company's job records, not on the caller's description: it compares the customer, the loss address and the loss date of the jobs on record, and looks at their status at the moment the new dispatch is booked.
- A job counts as open in the dispatched, authorized, drying, drying complete and invoiced statuses; a closed or cancelled job is not open.
- The quantity the check reads is the number of the customer's water jobs with the same loss address and the same loss date whose status is neither closed nor cancelled, taken at the moment of booking.

## Cases (hypothetical)
| Jobs on record for the customer | New call | Outcome under the standard |
|---|---|---|
| A job at the same address, same loss date, in drying status | Another call about that loss | No new job is opened; the call is handled on the existing job as a return visit. |
| A job at the same address, same loss date, in closed status | A call about that address and loss date | The closed job is not open, so this standard does not bar booking the dispatch. |
| A job at the same address with a different loss date, in invoiced status | A call about a new loss | The jobs differ in loss date, so this standard does not bar booking the dispatch. |

## Money between jobs
- A customer payment, an insurance posting, an adjustment credit or a refund always names one job and changes that job's balance only.
- A credit balance on a job is refunded from that same job; it is never moved to another job of the same customer.
